title: The simulator draws more image containers than the glasses show
claim: The display page allows at most 4 image containers per page. The official simulator, meant for checking layouts before hardware, draws more.
actual: One developer reports that the glasses show at most 4 image containers at once, while the simulator showed about 6. A layout that works in the simulator breaks on the glasses. The report gives no versions.
impact: Image-heavy layouts pass simulator testing and fail on hardware.
workaround: Keep to 4 image containers per page whatever the simulator shows.

evidence.note: Observed while building three apps, as of June 2026.
